exposure: Abnormal UA DV results (reduced flow, absent UA end diastolic flow, reversal of UA end diastolic flow)
cohort: 130 singleton pregnancies complicated by FGR (>=24 weeks gestation), confirmed to be small for gestational age (SGA) after birth.
finding: SGA infants born to mothers with abnormal UA DV findings had a significantly higher number of MUP lesions and increased neonatal morbidity.
birth_weight: Group 2 (abnormal DV) had significantly lower mean birth weights (1.59 kg) compared to group 1 (normal DV) (1.87 kg, p<0.001).
